Pre-release preview of the 1.3.0 dialog/drawer body copy changes.

### Changed

- **Field** — removed `autoValidation` input; set `errorText` from your form layer (breaking).
- **Dialog** / **Drawer** — body copy is projected through the default slot; `bodyText` and `bodyContent` inputs removed (breaking).
- Dialog and drawer bodies apply default body typography to projected copy (`p`, `strong`).

### Install

```bash
npm install @laczynski/ui@preview
```

Stable 1.3.0 will ship after preview validation.

Docs: https://ui.laczynski.dev/
